note: The 20 case slots for the development and held-out sets (#52). Families never straddle the split. Generated by the junior-dev-cases workflow; the writers never see the skill.

slots.topic: Email-and-password login for a small web app, using server-side sessions and a session cookie, including logout.
Moving third-party API keys out of a committed config file into encrypted storage, and how the app reads them at runtime.
Password reset by emailed one-time link, for a consumer app.
Adding 'Sign in with Google' (OAuth/OIDC) beside existing email-and-password accounts, including linking an existing account.
Checkout across cart, payment, inventory and order services, including a payment that succeeds after stock runs out.
Splitting the notifications code out of a monolith into its own service without losing or duplicating notifications.
Nightly ETL from the app database into a warehouse, handling rows that arrive late or are updated after export.
Clickstream ingestion from web and mobile clients, with deduplication and the ability to replay a day of events.
Moving the users table from MySQL to Postgres with no downtime, using dual writes and a backfill.
Feature-flagged rollout of a new billing engine: old only, shadow, both, new only, and rollback.
Adding CSV export to an existing reports page, including very large reports.
Adding per-customer rate limiting to a public REST API.
Event-driven order fulfilment using a transactional outbox, a message broker and three consuming services.
A webhook delivery service with retries, backoff, signatures and a dead-letter queue.
Fanning out a chat message to the recipients who are online, and storing it for those who are not.
Active-passive failover of a SaaS app and its primary database between two cloud regions.
Adding read replicas in two more regions, with writes still going to one primary, and routing reads by user location.
Blue-green deployment for a single web service behind a load balancer, including database migrations.
A CI/CD pipeline with build, test, staging and production gates, and a manual approval step.
A multi-tenant data model for a B2B project-tracking app, with tenant isolation enforced in the database.
